proposals.title: Daily tasks on Chats Home
proposals.oneLiner: A "Daily tasks" sheet on Chats Home: 3 sponsored 15-second games a day with Luzia, each rewarding 1 extra AI message.

newMechanic.name: Daily tasks
newMechanic.description: A Chats Home sheet listing 3 sponsored mini-game tasks per day, each paying 1 extra AI message toward the usage quota; resets at midnight.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Nothing renews daily today; a capped task list creates a daily habit and predictable inventory.

proposals.trigger: A "Daily tasks 0/3" badge on Chats Home; the user opens the sheet and picks a task. No pop-ups.
proposals.eligibility: Non-payers only (no purchase in the last 30 days), returning users from their second session on; suppressed for 24 h after any purchase and never shown to subscribers [TRIG-2] [CANN-4].

offer.title: Daily tasks
offer.body: Play a 15-second sponsored game to get 1 extra AI message. 3 tasks a day.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: At most 3 tasks a day; the free daily sources are unchanged. Non-payers only; capped per day; a remote-config kill switch rolls it back if paid conversion drops [CANN-4]. This reward (extra messages) is additive to the usage quota and not gated by Account Access, preserving the sign-up value proposition.
